name: Pinpoint
tagline: A map-first student housing platform where listings and roommate seekers share one view, with AI search.
problem: Student housing in Kingston is scattered across groups and classifieds, roommates are found elsewhere, and nothing is organised by location.
solution: Listings and people looking for roommates appear as pins on one map, with filters for budget, dates and lifestyle, and an AI search that matches plain-language requests.
demo_moment: Team-described: describe the place you want and see matching pins on the map.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “City of Kingston Prize Track” among 77 submissions.
A local problem every Queen's student recognises.

lessons: A city-sponsored track rewards problems residents of that city feel today.
